threat_cases.evidence: The enabled factory receives registry bytes and all expected roots in one caller-supplied trust_boundary.
The direct boolean gate returns research_only, but the OOS/in-sample assertion is not rebuilt from the frozen learning result.
The fixture flag is fail-closed, but complete lineage is represented by counts and booleans rather than a verified Action 665 graph.
Plan equality catches one-sided drift; a self-consistent alternative post can replace both asserted evidence and plan.
The proposal layer does not replay the Action 665 opportunity-set contract or its candidate membership.
One-sided digest tampering fails; a replacement trusted registry can authorize a self-consistent alternative primary metric.
Sample minimum changes the semantic digest but not plan_identity and there is no previous-binding lookup.
Validation checks only that every remaining plan metric exists in evidence; it does not require equality with the complete protected set.
One-sided mismatch fails, but both evidence and plan floors can be replaced under a self-authorized registry.
The layer compares two asserted tuples but does not verify arm roles against the paired Action 666 evaluation.
A missing/none method remains research_only, but adjusted values and the selected hypothesis family are not recomputed.
All canonical post and registry builders are public and the factory accepts the replacement registry/root tuple.
Duplicates inside one post fail, but duplicate proposal/plan identities across distinct registry posts are not checked.
All output safety flags are hard-coded false and no live call-site exists.
Caller-supplied approved_experiment_candidate items are rejected, but self-authorized upstream evidence can still satisfy the derived gate.
no_change returns before split stability, in_sample_only, data-quality-rate and multiple-testing gates.
Stable count derives from a caller-authored direction string, not the signed effect value or a verified OOS split result.
Period and point-in-time checks rely on lexical strings and asserted booleans without timestamp parsing or interval verification.
Evidence item source digests are format-bound but not checked against the corresponding canonical section digest inventory.
The named test changes expected_registry_root_digest only; it does not rebuild registry and expected root together.
